posts.title: Zelda remake gets two native PC ports with frame generation
posts.excerpt: Hookshot and NX2navi rebuild the Zelda remake natively for PC, with frame generation and DLSS/FSR upscaling. On one tester's RTX 5090, frame generation pushed Hookshot to 180 fps.
posts.body: [Hookshot and NX2navi](https://wccftech.com/zelda-ocarina-of-time-remake-pc-recompilation-switch-2-emulator-ps5/) rebuild the Zelda remake natively for PC, with frame generation and DLSS/FSR upscaling. On one tester's RTX 5090, frame generation pushed Hookshot to 180 fps.

posts.title: LG opens K-EXAONE 2.5 API for free

posts.body: [Developers, startups, and research institutions can get an API key through LG's developer platform](https://www.digitaltoday.co.kr/en/view/122771/lg-ai-research-opens-k-exaone-2-5-api-free-says-performance-up-70-percent) and use K-EXAONE 2.5 for service development and research without additional cost. LG says the model improved more than 70 percent against the version released in August, based on a combined assessment of 24 evaluation metrics.

posts.title: Senate votes 60-40 to advance deal ending 40-day shutdown
posts.excerpt: The Senate voted 60-40 on Sunday night to advance the bipartisan deal to end the 40-day shutdown, the longest in U.S. history. It reverses the shutdown firings, restoring those jobs with back pay.
posts.body: The [Senate voted 60-40 on Sunday night](http://mohintechbd.blogspot.com/2026/11/blog-post_796.html) to advance the bipartisan deal to end the 40-day shutdown, the longest in U.S. history. It reverses the shutdown firings, restoring those jobs with back pay.

posts.title: DeepMind AI found two weaknesses in 1024-bit RSA
posts.excerpt: DeepMind's AI agents found two weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA on November 6, working under human supervision alongside academic cryptographers. The headline 1,600x speedup is a theoretical…
posts.body: [DeepMind's AI agents found two weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA](https://aitoolsrecap.com/Blog/deepmind-ai-agents-rsa-1024-weaknesses-2026) on November 6, working under human supervision alongside academic cryptographers. The headline 1,600x speedup is a theoretical estimate, while the reproduction that actually ran used 3.5 times less CPU time than the earlier method.

posts.title: CoreWeave will pay its own grid costs in Texas
posts.excerpt: CoreWeave will pay for the substations and grid connections for its new Texas data centers, CEO Michael Intrator told Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa in a November 7 letter. The offer lands as Hinojosa…
posts.body: [CoreWeave will pay for the substations and grid connections for its new Texas data centers](https://cryptobriefing.com/coreweave-self-fund-texas-data-center-costs/), CEO Michael Intrator told Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa in a November 7 letter. The offer lands as Hinojosa weighs a moratorium on new data-center approvals until Texas sets rules for power, water, and community say.

posts.title: SpaceX to conduct 15th Starship test launch in mid-November
posts.excerpt: SpaceX said Flight 15 could launch as early as Friday, Nov 13, pending regulatory approval, with the 75-minute window opening at 4:45 PM CT. The mission will be the first attempt to catch both…
posts.body: [SpaceX said](https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/world/2026/11/08/spacex-to-conduct-15th-starship-test-launch-in-mid-november) Flight 15 could launch as early as Friday, Nov 13, pending regulatory approval, with the 75-minute window opening at 4:45 PM CT. The mission will be the first attempt to catch both Starship and its Super Heavy booster at the launch site.

posts.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash stretches video to 15 seconds for less
posts.excerpt: Google made Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available on November 5, with native video clips up to 15 seconds. It also adds multi-turn conversational editing, so a clip can be refined turn by turn…
posts.body: [Google made Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/introducing-gemini-omni-1-2-flash/) on November 5, with native video clips up to 15 seconds. It also adds multi-turn conversational editing, so a clip can be refined turn by turn instead of regenerated from scratch.

posts.title: Jailbroken PS5 now runs Android, Switch 2, and PC games
posts.excerpt: Hydroid lets a jailbroken PS5 run 64-bit Android games directly, without Linux or a virtual machine, Android Authority reported November 2. It works only on firmware 13.60 or below, which Sony has…
posts.body: [Hydroid lets a jailbroken PS5 run 64-bit Android games directly](https://mobile.androidauthority.com/ps5-run-android-switch-2-pc-games-3730686/), without Linux or a virtual machine, Android Authority reported November 2. It works only on firmware 13.60 or below, which Sony has already patched for online play.

posts.title: Claude can now read your bank account and explain your spending
posts.excerpt: Anthropic announced Personal Finance for Claude on Thursday, letting you link bank and credit card accounts through Plaid and ask where your money is going. The access is read-only, so Claude cannot…
posts.body: Anthropic announced [Personal Finance for Claude](https://phandroid.com/2026/11/06/claude-can-now-read-your-bank-account-and-explain-your-spending/amp/) on Thursday, letting you link bank and credit card accounts through Plaid and ask where your money is going. The access is read-only, so Claude cannot move, manage, or invest your money.

posts.title: SpaceX targets 2027 launch for orbital supercomputers with NVIDIA
posts.excerpt: SpaceX plans to begin launching its StarMind SI computing systems into orbit in the third quarter of 2027, with deployment accelerating through 2028 and 2029. The first systems will run on NVIDIA's…
posts.body: SpaceX plans to [begin launching its StarMind SI computing systems into orbit](https://interestingengineering.com/ai-robotics/spacex-starmind-orbital-supercomputers) in the third quarter of 2027, with deployment accelerating through 2028 and 2029. The first systems will run on NVIDIA's Vera Rubin NVL72 platform, developed alongside NVIDIA.

posts.title: Haitian third-grader placed in ORR care after check-in
posts.excerpt: An 8-year-old Haitian third-grader at Fay Elementary in San Diego was taken into federal custody after an ICE check-in this week. DHS said his uncle could not establish legal guardianship, so the boy…
posts.body: An 8-year-old Haitian third-grader at Fay Elementary in San Diego was taken into federal custody after an ICE check-in this week. DHS said his uncle could not establish legal guardianship, so the boy was determined an unaccompanied minor and placed in ORR care, according to [USA TODAY](https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2026/11/07/haitian-third-grader-taken-into-federal-custody/92661950007/).

posts.title: Democrats took both houses in midterm sweep
posts.excerpt: Democrats seized control of both houses of Congress in Tuesday's midterm elections, winning in Republican strongholds including Kansas and Texas. In Kansas, Adam Hamilton won the party's first Senate…
posts.body: [Democrats seized control of both houses of Congress](https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/how-democrats-won-their-blowout-midterm-victory-2026-11-07/) in Tuesday's midterm elections, winning in Republican strongholds including Kansas and Texas. In Kansas, Adam Hamilton won the party's first Senate race there since 1932.

posts.title: Mexican police fatally shoot 7-year-old American girl
posts.excerpt: Published Nov 7, 2026, 11:30 AM Tamaulipas prosecutors confirmed Friday that police gunfire from a helicopter killed Aranza, a seven-year-old born in the United States, in Matamoros on October 29.…
posts.body: Published Nov 7, 2026, 11:30 AM [Tamaulipas prosecutors confirmed Friday](https://gulfnews.com/amp/story/world%2Famericas%2Fmexico-confirms-police-shot-us-girl-dead-in-cartel-chase-1.500739284) that police gunfire from a helicopter killed Aranza, a seven-year-old born in the United States, in Matamoros on October 29. Her mother said the family stopped their pickup and her husband got out to say they were civilians with children, but they were fired at anyway.

posts.title: Amazon brings AI-powered Alexa shopping assistant to text messages
posts.excerpt: Amazon said US customers can use its Alexa for Shopping assistant to search for products and make purchases through text messages. The feature is rolling out first to a small group of invited US…
posts.body: [Amazon](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/info-tech/amazon-lets-us-customers-shop-through-text-messages-using-ai-powered-alexa/article71677133.ece) said US customers can use its Alexa for Shopping assistant to search for products and make purchases through text messages.
